tests.name: text
tests.content: A compressor pumps a refrigerant gas through coils, raising its pressure and temperature. This hot gas releases heat to the surrounding room air as it condenses into a liquid. The liquid then expands in the interior coils, absorbing heat from the fridge's contents and turning back into a cold gas to repeat the cycle.

tests.name: reasoning
tests.content:
**17 × 19 = 323**

**Calculation:** I used the distributive property by rewriting 19 as (20 − 1):

17 × 19 = 17 × (20 − 1) = 340 − 17 = **323**

smoke.note: Synthetic local smoke tests. Tool calls were inspected only, never executed. Not a quality or throughput benchmark.

notes: The 255-token case checks survival and output equivalence; MTP's mandatory one-block exclusion leaves no reusable checkpoint at this length.

Mixed batches contain one 4095-input/1-output request and three 2049-input/16-output requests. Output IDs match separately computed cold controls. Ignore-EOS is deliberate to sustain the short rows through decoding.
All prompts and image inputs are synthetic. These are functional and latency qualification measurements, not a broad model-quality or throughput benchmark.
Production-shaped measurements use the final installed package with 8 GiB RAM, active-only GPU retention, 262144 context, four sequences, two speculative MTP tokens and two-image support.
The exact context ceiling is exercised twice using RAM from the preceding full-context prefix; a fresh completed request after each ceiling request verifies deferred store flushing.
The 64-history eviction cohort exceeds the fixed 8 GiB RAM tier through recurrent checkpoints. The newest history still hits RAM; the oldest 20K history recomputes with identical output IDs.
The original source-overlay measurements and pre-fix exploratory runs are separate artifacts. This file reports the final declared qualification datasets only.
Short smoke and deferred-flush probes do not request token IDs; full-context, exact-limit, lifecycle, parallel and boundary cases retain token IDs for equivalence checks.
